definitions.explanation: The eighth sign of the Western zodiac, covering people born roughly October 24 to November 22. Also the constellation Scorpius. Used in horoscopes and casual talk about star signs; often written with the kana さそり{座|ざ}.

examples.japanese: {蠍座|さそりざ}の{人|ひと}は{情熱的|じょうねつてき}だと{言|い}われる。
examples.english: Scorpio people are said to be passionate.

examples.japanese: {占|うらな}いで、{今月|こんげつ}の{蠍座|さそりざ}は{勝負|しょうぶ}に{強|つよ}い{時期|じき}だと{言|い}われた。
examples.english: The horoscope said this month is a strong period for Scorpio in competitions.

notes:
The zodiac sign Scorpio, for people born from late October to late November. Because {蠍|さそり} is an uncommon kanji, the kana spelling さそり{座|ざ} is very common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {蠍座|さそりざ}の{人|ひと}: a person born under Scorpio
- {蠍座|さそりざ}{生|う}まれ: born a Scorpio
- {蠍座|さそりざ}の{運勢|うんせい}: the Scorpio horoscope

USAGE:
Star signs are common small-talk in Japan and appear in magazine and morning-TV horoscope segments ({星占|ほしうらな}い).
